# Start here

::: {.callout-important}
This real-study section is a scaffold. No real dataset or real findings are bundled yet.
:::

The real-study case study is **not yet selected or bundled**. Complete synthetic practice now; return here after a source has passed the verification checklist.

The first case study should be a quantitative trait with full genome-wide summary statistics, beta and SE on a documented scale, effect alleles/frequencies, N, build and source quality information. A short table of published significant hits cannot support the same Q–Q or calibration diagnostics.

See `data/provenance/REAL-STUDY-PLAN.md` for acceptance criteria. We will not fill this section with invented measurements or present simulated figures as real findings.
